Last year, we decided to get an MRI, which revealed that I had spinal canal stenosis at L4 - L5 with cord compression. Unfortunately, even after continuing medications and physiotherapy, my condition did not improve.
About six months ago, my sister recommended Dr. Kunal Bhardwaj, MS Ortho, from SRV Hospitals, Chembur. As soon as we consulted him, he advised immediate surgery. Within a month, I underwent MIS TLIF L4-L5 with decompression and laminectomy. The surgery lasted around five hours and was successfully carried out.
Now, two months post-surgery, I’m doing much better with the support of physiotherapy. The pain has significantly reduced, and I’m able to move around and return to my routine work.
I am deeply grateful to Dr. Kunal Bhardwaj and his team for the successful treatment and well-planned surgery that helped me regain my quality of life.

Meet Dr. Vikas Yadav – where arrogance is free, but respect is out of stock.
